title: FBI Photo B11
what_is_it: A monochrome still image (photo) captured by a U.S. military sensor system, showing an unidentified anomalous phenomenon (UAP).
interpretation_warnings: The extracted text from the image is heavily garbled — most alphanumeric HUD data is unreadable, limiting independent analysis.
Heavy redactions were applied before the image reached AARO, meaning potentially identifying sensor or platform details have been removed.
No mission report accompanies the image, so there is no operational context for the sighting.
The date stamp on the image is confirmed unreliable due to an unconfigured system clock.
Single-source observation with no corroborating sensor data or witness reports provided.
The narrative description from the CSV metadata explicitly states it should not be interpreted as an analytical judgment or factual determination.
